A. positive-pressure duct systems

The static regain method is not appropriate for low-pressure duct systems, as it calculates the duct size based on the amount of static pressure that can be sustained in the duct, which may not be accurate for duct systems that are subject to low pressure or negative pressure. Zoning and system selection are important factors in designing a heating and cooling system.
